name: Azeroth Companion
title: Reliability Center & Player Experience
features: Added character lookup connection and recovery guidance to Live Armory, including clear success, partial equipment and failure states.
Added a matching Item Codex recovery panel with manually initiated Retry Last Entry using original form validation and lookup handling.
Browser-reported online/offline status now helps players understand connectivity and disables retry when the browser is offline, without claiming game-service uptime.
Distinguishes timed-out requests, connection problems, possible rate limits and upstream failures without automatic retry traffic or new API permissions.
Preserves Talent Forge, saved character and item information, Gear Mastery, HYPER MUSIC and the existing release delivery system. Live testing remains pending until players are available.
